About the Team 
 Our sales and partner management teams are the heart and soul of DoorDash, enabling us to sign and partner with top restaurants and New Verticals merchants to drive revenue and help our partners operate and grow their businesses. As DoorDash grows both in scale and breadth of offering, the strength of our sales engine and organizational structure must grow with it. Our Enterprise sales organization partners with the largest national and regional restaurant and New Verticals brands across the US and Canada, from signing new partners to growing and retaining our most strategic accounts.

 About Accenture CEO Advisory 
 Accenture CEO Advisory works with chief executives, boards and their leadership teams on the decisions that set enterprise direction: where to compete, what to own, how to fund a shift in the portfolio, and what the operating model has to become to support it. The work sits upstream of execution but is judged on whether it survives contact with it, so we pair industry depth with the quantitative, technology and delivery capability to pressure-test an answer before a client commits capital behind it.
 About Accenture Commodity Markets 
 Accenture Commodity Markets (ACM), part of Accenture CEO Advisory, is a global practice operating across multiple industries. Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.
